verdict.rationale: The evidence shows 1Password stores one-time passwords and offers a CLI, SDKs, Connect, and service accounts for programmatic item access. But no item shows the CLI or any API returning a current TOTP code for an automated 2FA login. General item-management and OTP-storage features are adjacent capabilities and do not establish this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
